common_mistakes.arithmetic-error: Adding figures without dated working, so a mid-period shortfall or total is miscalculated — re-add each figure line by line and state every calculation
common_mistakes.assumes-missing-information: Filling an unstated gap with a guess instead of naming it — list each fact not given and state what must be checked before deciding
common_mistakes.misses-access-constraint: Planning as if transport, step-free access, timing or adjustments do not matter — account for the access need explicitly and state the adjustment request
common_mistakes.overconfident-conclusion: Stating one certain answer when the evidence allows several readings — match the conclusion to the evidence and name what would change the decision
